motivation: The separate tail audit found that the12bit fixed-log-span encoding preserves relative tails but degrades core precision. Measure16bit tradeoffs before choosing a diagnostic reference.
representation: Same fixed512 binary-amplitude-exponent span and zero-support semantics as log12, using16bits per coordinate; no held-out dictionary adaptation or range tuning.
decision_scope: Compare metrics and costs without inventing a pass threshold or claiming continuous/posterior/lifetime qualification.
preservation: All primary, tail and prequalification artifacts remain hash-bound and unchanged.
